learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Hello Parkes.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: During the above, PENNY looks out the door, waves. She rushes to a mirror and nervously checks her make-up. RODNEY appears at the caravan door. He is attractive but very earnest. PENNY whirls around when he appears, and smiles at him breathlessly. RODNEY smiles back nervously and runs up the stairs.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: too late

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Mind your head....

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: RODNEY bumps his head.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Ah!

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: He stumbles around clutching his head. PENNY rushes to him.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Darling, are you all right? Rodney?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: He pushes her away frantically, still holding his head.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Oh my God.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I know. I did it too.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Oh, oh my God.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: PENNY looks out the door.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Where’s Monica?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: rubs his head, as the pain subsides

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Parkes is showing her where he used to have the caravan. Somebody’s taken his spot apparently.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: PENNY shuts the door. She stands against it, waiting expectantly. RODNEY looks at her nervously.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Darling?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Yes?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Don’t I get a kiss?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: She stands expectantly. RODNEY quickly pecks her and leaps away when she tried to embrace him.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: That’s not much of a kiss.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: RODNEY nervously looks out the door.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Well. Here we are.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Laughs nervously

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: God that’s a long drive, though. Monica almost passed out in the heat. Why are you looking at me like that?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I’m sorry, Rodney. I have to say it. I’m very hurt.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Touching head innocently

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Hurt? Why?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: It’s been two weeks. You never rang.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I’ve been very busy, Penny. There’s a whole new...er... and we’re up to...er...and really, there’s been no time. Really.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: He runs down. Pause.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: You’re feeling guilty?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Just a little bit, yes.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: How do you think I feel? Monica’s my best friend.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I know! And if she ever found out.....

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I know! If Parkes ever found out.....

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I know! I know! Which is why we’ve got to be careful.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: We have been careful. We couldn’t be more careful! Once in two weeks.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Pause.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Penny, we were drunk.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Not that drunk! It was wonderful. It was wonderful for you, wasn’t it?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Yes, yes of course, but.....

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Oh, darling. Darling.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: She embraces him. He leaps away and back to the door.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Penny, Penny, Penny!!! They could come in at any moment!

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Wouldn’t you have done it if you had been sober?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I.....yes, of course....but.... I might have thought more seriously about the consequences.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I see. Fine.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: A pause, and then a wail.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Why couldn’t I have had my first affair with somebody else? Why did it have to be my best friend who’s married to my other best friend?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: You’re talking very loudly.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I don’t care!

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: Shhhh!!

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I can’t help it. I’ve never been unfaithful before, Rodney. I’ve never taken a lover before. In all these years. Rodney, please. Kiss me.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: No! Monica and Parkes could come in. We have to be careful.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I can’t stand it. I don’t think I’ll be able to stand it.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: You really have to control yourself. Look, it was only one night. It’s hardly an affair. We can’t have an affair.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: DIRECTOR
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: A long pause.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: I’m terribly sorry. You’re right, of course.

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: We can’t, can we?

learn_rodney_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
learn_rodney_director_1_5x.text: No. Of course we can’t.

parkes_clone_full_director_1_5x.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_director_1_5x.text: We can’t, can we?

parkes_clone_full_director_1_5x.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_director_1_5x.text: No. Of course we can’t.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Hello Parkes.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Mind your head....

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Ah!

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Darling, are you all right? Rodney?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Oh my God.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I know. I did it too.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Oh, oh my God.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Where’s Monica?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Parkes is showing her where he used to have the caravan. Somebody’s taken his spot apparently.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Darling?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Yes?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Don’t I get a kiss?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: That’s not much of a kiss.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Well. Here we are.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: God that’s a long drive, though. Monica almost passed out in the heat. Why are you looking at me like that?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I’m sorry, Rodney. I have to say it. I’m very hurt.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Hurt? Why?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: It’s been two weeks. You never rang.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I’ve been very busy, Penny. There’s a whole new...er... and we’re up to...er...and really, there’s been no time. Really.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: You’re feeling guilty?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Just a little bit, yes.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: How do you think I feel? Monica’s my best friend.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I know! And if she ever found out.....

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I know! If Parkes ever found out.....

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I know! I know! Which is why we’ve got to be careful.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: We have been careful. We couldn’t be more careful! Once in two weeks.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Penny, we were drunk.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Not that drunk! It was wonderful. It was wonderful for you, wasn’t it?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Yes, yes of course, but.....

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Oh, darling. Darling.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Penny, Penny, Penny!!! They could come in at any moment!

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Wouldn’t you have done it if you had been sober?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I.....yes, of course....but.... I might have thought more seriously about the consequences.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I see. Fine.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Why couldn’t I have had my first affair with somebody else? Why did it have to be my best friend who’s married to my other best friend?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: You’re talking very loudly.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I don’t care!

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: Shhhh!!

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I can’t help it. I’ve never been unfaithful before, Rodney. I’ve never taken a lover before. In all these years. Rodney, please. Kiss me.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: No! Monica and Parkes could come in. We have to be careful.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I can’t stand it. I don’t think I’ll be able to stand it.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: You really have to control yourself. Look, it was only one night. It’s hardly an affair. We can’t have an affair.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: I’m terribly sorry. You’re right, of course.

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: RODNEY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: We can’t, can we?

parkes_clone_full_no_director.speaker: PENNY
parkes_clone_full_no_director.text: No. Of course we can’t.
